# Add New Calendar

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Create's a new calendar with the given name.

## Syntax

~~~~text
addNewCalendar(name: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
addNewCalendar(name: "My new calendar")
~~~~
